name: Avocado & Black Bean Power Bowl
description: Nutritious, delicious avocado & black bean power bowl with balanced macros and simple prep.
instructions: Cook grains (quinoa or brown rice) according to package instructions and allow to cool slightly.
Chop fresh vegetables (cucumbers, tomatoes, greens, avocado) into bite-sized pieces.
Cook or prepare the protein seasoned with herbs and lemon juice.
Whisk together the light dressing with lemon juice, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Assemble the power bowl by arranging grains, vegetables, and protein in sections, then drizzle with dressing.

name: Banging beef burrito
description: Nutritious, delicious banging beef burrito with balanced macros and simple prep.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat with cooking spray.
Cook the protein (lean beef or chicken strips) with Mexican spices (cumin, paprika, chilli flakes) until browned.
Warm the tortillas or wraps in a dry pan for 20 seconds each to make them pliable.
Layer each wrap with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, beans, cooked protein, and avocado or cottage cheese.
Tightly fold the sides in and roll up firmly. Slice in half and serve warm or wrap in foil for meal prep.

name: Berry overnight oats
description: Nutritious, delicious berry overnight oats with balanced macros and simple prep.
instructions: In a bowl or meal prep jar, combine rolled oats, protein powder, and a pinch of salt.
Pour in the almond milk or water and stir thoroughly until no lumps remain.
Fold in any fruit, sweetener, or cinnamon.
Seal and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours) to thicken into a creamy pudding.
Top with your favourite toppings (berries, nuts, or peanut butter) before enjoying!

instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat with cooking spray.

name: Bold cheesy beef gnocchi
description: Nutritious, delicious bold cheesy beef gnocchi with balanced macros and simple prep.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until they float, then drain.
Heat a skillet over medium heat with cooking spray. Brown the lean mince with diced onion and seasonings.
Pour in marinara sauce or passata and simmer on low for 5 minutes until rich and fragrant.
Gently fold the boiled gnocchi into the simmering beef sauce.
Top with cheese, cover with a lid for 2 minutes until melted and bubbly, then portion out.

name: Boss burger & fries
description: Nutritious, delicious boss burger & fries with balanced macros and simple prep.
instructions: Shape the lean mince or patties into even rounds, seasoning generously with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Preheat a heavy skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat with cooking spray.
Sear the burger patties for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and nicely charred.
Lightly toast the burger buns. If making homemade fries, air fry the potato wedges at 200°C for 18-20 minutes.
Assemble each burger with crisp lettuce, fresh tomato slices, sauce, and the cooked patties. Serve hot!

name: Butter chicken curry
description: Nutritious, delicious butter chicken curry with balanced macros and simple prep.
instructions: Cut the chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and season with curry powder, cumin, turmeric, and salt.
Heat a deep skillet or pot over medium heat. Sear the chicken pieces until lightly browned on all sides.
Add diced aromatics (onion, garlic, ginger) and saute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato puree, light coconut milk or yoghurt, and simmer gently for 10-12 minutes until chicken is tender.
Serve hot over basmati rice or with warmed roti, garnished with fresh coriander.
